FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 142
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/03/2023
Senate Bill 142 as introduced provides for the altering, rearrangement and extension of the
corporate limits of the City of Spanish Fort which could increase the administrative and
financial obligations of the City of Spanish Fort to provide essential public services to
previously unincorporated areas. However, this increase could be offset, wholly or in part, by
the increase in tax receipts gained from the newly incorporated areas.
